Subject: Request: regional warm-start keystore witness + RTO/RPO artifacts

Hi Tessa / Marissa,

We're in the middle of a SIG/SOC2 evidence pull for our 4Q audit. Two asks from our security and resilience teams: 1) a narrow set of artifacts demonstrating a regional warm-start (keystore unseal/rotation + KV cache warm restore) and the measured RTO/RPO for that scenario, and 2) scheduling a short live witness (video + screen-share) where an engineer walks through the warm-start trace and answers a few follow-up questions.

Concretely we need:
- keystore unseal and rotation timestamps (logs with UTC timestamps) for the most recent warm-start (or a representative rehearsal)
- kv-cache snapshot timestamps and restoration duration, plus the associated sequence numbers
- end-to-end measured RTO (time from failover trigger to service recovery) and RPO (last accepted token index) for the event
- tabletop exercise minutes that reference the warm-start flow (for context)

Can you share those artifacts (redact secrets) and propose 30-45 minute witness windows next week? We're coordinating with procurement as well (David copied).

Thanks,
Claire Park
CISO, Pinnacle Bank
